name: Vo Thi Sau memorial
nameVi: Lễ giỗ Anh hùng lực lượng vũ trang nhân dân Võ Thị Sáu
summary: The special-zone notice of 29 December 2025 set the 74th memorial on 22 and 23 January 2026, the span 23 January 1952 to 23 January 2026. The vigil was 09:00 on 23 January 2026 at her grave in Hàng Dương, then the rite at Đền thờ Côn Đảo: incense, a dance to open the rite, offerings, a memorial reading, and the sharing of the offering. The day before included a student quiz. Later civil dates are check on arrival. The photograph is the cemetery gate, not the 2026 vigil. This is not the Vũng Tàu memorial.
when: 22–23 January 2026 for the 74th memorial. Vigil 09:00 on 23 January 2026 at Hàng Dương. Later years: check on arrival.
